item.title: Vanguard Commute Briefing — Nov 17, 2026
item.description:
Welcome to the Skyline Vanguard Daily Briefing, the twenty-minute commute podcast for real estate and insurance professionals. I'm Tawny. And I'm Paul. Good morning. Here's what matters today. Our lead is a Cotality report that puts rising weather risk, insurance nonrenewals, and softer home prices in the same frame. Second, the mortgage insurance fund at the Federal Housing Administration, and a debate over whether premiums should come down.
